cards.front: When can an infinite geometric series be summed?
cards.back: Only when |r| < 1, then S∞ = u₁/(1 − r). Otherwise it diverges.
The 10th term uses n − 1 = 9 jumps, not 10. Using n gives one d too many.

cards.front: Paper 1 vs Paper 2 calculator rule (Math AA SL)?
cards.back: Paper 1: NO calculator — exact values (fractions, surds, logs by hand). Paper 2: GDC required. Practise Paper 1 without a GDC from day one.

cards.front: Growth model: value doubles every 9 years — expression after t years?
cards.back: Proportional to 2^(t/9). Doubling time T → multiplier 2^(t/T).

cards.front: What is a sequence vs a series?
cards.back: Sequence = the list of terms (u₁, u₂, …). Series = the SUM of the terms (Sₙ). Words matter in questions.
